statement: A family ends cosec.jwt.session.lifetime after its login, however often it was refreshed: a refresh after that is refused and the user signs in again, no pair outlives that end, and a tenant switch, which does not sign the user in again, keeps the login time.
guards: login:TokenFamiliesTest#a family ends at its absolute lifetime
jwt:RefreshTokenFamiliesJwtTest#a pair never outlives its session
login:SwitchTenantAuthenticationTest#the new session keeps the login time of the session switched from
